ledger_health_guards.basis: provisional safety thresholds; validate against repeated healthy-host p95 measurements before enforcement

research_state_architecture.hot_state: authoritative research_proactive_memory current-state rows keyed by memory_id; certification uses namespace-local SQLite only
research_state_architecture.archive: append-only daily JSONL partitions with numbered 64 MiB maximum segments under the external Research state root
research_state_architecture.temporary_get_case_legacy_recovery_reaso: Pre-cutover operator recovery compatibility only; get_case requires allow_bounded_local_recovery=true and ordinary live calls fail closed.
research_state_architecture.temporary_get_case_legacy_recovery_remov: Remove after State v2 release is activated, seed lineage is verified, and source ledger has been atomically quarantined with rollback path retained.

research_state_v2_persistence.current_state_backend: Supabase research_proactive_memory; SQLite only in isolated certification namespace
research_state_v2_persistence.objective_id_lookup: objective_id indexed column, then exact memory_id hydration
research_state_v2_persistence.project_id_lookup: bounded payload project_id equality projection, then exact memory_id hydration
research_state_v2_persistence.job_id_lookup: bounded payload job_id equality projection, then exact memory_id hydration
research_state_v2_persistence.history_partition: UTC daily JSONL; numbered segments when a partition reaches its byte cap
research_state_v2_persistence.reconciliation: bounded replay of durable pending intents; current upsert is idempotent and archive replay checks the locked partition tail event_id
research_state_v2_persistence.limits_rationale: Daily UTC partitions bound age; 64 MiB segments cap single-file growth; 64 KiB event and 256 KiB current-record caps bound individual writes; four adjacent segment probes cover the hinted active segment, stale/partial rotation recovery, and the next writable segment while failing closed instead of scanning archive history; lookup target retains the existing provisional 1 s runtime-contract ceiling pending healthy-host measurements.
